facts.business: Haldyn Glass Limited manufactures a diverse range of glass containers for packaging, catering to alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverage, food, pharmaceutical, personal care, and homecare industries, including flint and coloured (amber/brown and green) glass bottles.
key_risks: US tariff escalations and trade policy uncertainty affecting glass and packaging exports
Geopolitical tensions (Russia-Ukraine conflict, Middle East hostilities, new armed conflict in March 2026) impacting global trade routes, freight costs, and energy markets
Substitution by other packing alternatives in low value brands and reuse of bottles by customers
Inflationary pressures due to oil shocks
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in Note 36 of the standalone financial statements.
